_help: Har collection ke liye read/write rule. Levels: public (bina login), auth (koi bhi login, Firebase anonymous bhi), owner (sirf banane wala + admin), admin (sirf admin), none (sabke liye band, admin ke liye bhi). Jo collection yaha nahi hai uspe 'default' lagta hai. createdByGuard = firestore.rules ke questionBank jaisa 'createdBy' niyam.
